records.historical_guard_assessment: Only the nine declared generic GTDB fields and actual native appended events may change. The source names the final species but canonical records contain no strain codes or assembly links; this correction must not invent them. Preserve all nine members, roles, abundance labels and biological assertions without recertifying those fields. Keep HYPOTHESIZED network complementarity distinct from measured removal, the separate-treatment versus mixed-treatment efficiencies, DNA-relative abundance versus viable counts, and the PARTIAL ratio-intervention arrow. Live OPEN issue 1468 still owns PFOS/atrazine denominator and method discrepancies, non-graph role/mechanism claims and missing raw/supplement reconciliation. The immutable batch42 self-adversarial assessment is not a new scientific clearance. Its current biological predicates for GENIA, Fucoidan and Transwell remain; preserve the accepted disjoint Fucoidan449 successor and Transwell's historical baseline chain. Later strict admission may project only this admitted predecessor for GENIA's old hash/last-event assertions. Source taxonomy correspondence does not close any scientific issue.
